name: Shushan Susa
overview: Shushan Susa was the prominent capital city and royal palace of the Medo-Persian Empire, serving as the central seat of King Ahasuerus's reign. Scripture highlights its significance as the setting for key events, including royal feasts and the gathering of maidens for the king's court, as seen in Esther and Nehemiah. The city also provides the backdrop for God's providential care over His people, exemplified by Mordecai and Esther residing within the palace walls.
